description: This file defines a report class for production planning in an ERP system, including data retrieval, processing, and report generation logic for manufacturing orders, raw materials, and inventory details.

classes.name: ProductionPlanReport
classes.description: Main class for generating production planning report, handling data collection, processing, and column setup.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Entry point function to generate the report, instantiates ProductionPlanReport and calls execute_report.

methods.name: ProductionPlanReport.__init__
methods.description: Initializes report object with filters, setting up data structures.

methods.name: ProductionPlanReport.execute_report
methods.description: Coordinates data retrieval and processing steps, returns report columns and data.

methods.name: ProductionPlanReport.get_open_orders
methods.description: Fetches open manufacturing or order data based on filters.

methods.name: ProductionPlanReport.prepare_other_conditions
methods.description: Prepares SQL filter conditions based on filters and doctype.

methods.name: ProductionPlanReport.get_raw_materials
methods.description: Retrieves raw materials associated with orders, including BOM and work order items.

methods.name: ProductionPlanReport.get_item_details
methods.description: Fetches default warehouse info for items.

methods.name: ProductionPlanReport.get_bin_details
methods.description: Gets inventory bin quantities for items and warehouses.

methods.name: ProductionPlanReport.get_purchase_details
methods.description: Retrieves purchase order arrival info for raw materials.

methods.name: ProductionPlanReport.prepare_data
methods.description: Prepares final data set for report, including available quantities.

methods.name: ProductionPlanReport.update_raw_materials
methods.description: Calculates remaining raw material quantities and allocates from warehouses.

methods.name: ProductionPlanReport.pick_materials_from_warehouses
methods.description: Allocates raw materials from specified warehouses, updating quantities.

methods.name: ProductionPlanReport.get_args
methods.description: Creates a template dict for report rows.

methods.name: ProductionPlanReport.get_columns
methods.description: Defines report columns based on filters.
